command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm smoke:delivery-broker-coupling && pnpm smoke:delivery-lease:auth

mutations.name: the daemon never reacts to a lease watch event (the loss window reverts to the renew period)
mutations.expectRed: L4 and the daemon's log names the watch-driven loss rather than a renew failure
mutations.cell: L4 and the daemon's log names the watch-driven loss rather than a renew failure
mutations.note: The watch trigger's own-write/foreign-write branch removed: every event, including the daemon's own acquire/renew/ready writes, is ignored. The loser still exits via the renew tick, so L5 can stay green while the loss window is back to ~15s; the cells that die are L3 (the 5s bound) and L4 (the watch-named loss line). Measured at the base shape: 14588ms.

why: THE COMMAND REBUILDS BEFORE EVERY RUN: the daemon child runs `bin/cotal.ts` via tsx, which
resolves workspace packages to their compiled dist, so a source mutant is invisible until
built. The first version of this fixture ran the suites bare and the mutant read UNGRADABLE
for exactly that reason (measured: the suite passed with the trigger removed because the
child never saw it). The `pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build` prefix is what makes the mutation
reach the process under test; the tool's restore verifies source, not dist, so rebuild once
by hand after a proof to keep dist matched to the restored source.
